name: PM-KISAN income support
summary: Direct income support for landholding farmer families, paid in instalments to the bank account.
benefits: Fixed cash instalments per year, transferred directly to the bank account
No middleman: money reaches the account with Aadhaar linkage
Status and instalment history visible on the official portal
eligibility: Landholding farmer family with cultivable land in the applicant's name
Not an income-tax payer, and not holding a constitutional post or high government office
Aadhaar-linked bank account in the applicant's own name
extra_costs: Registration is free
If land is inherited, mutation (namantaran) at the tehsil costs a nominal fee
CSC help, if you use one, may charge a small service fee

where_to_go.office: Online (pmkisan.gov.in) or your nearest CSC / agriculture office
where_to_go.note: Land record corrections happen at the tehsil / land records office

steps: Register on pmkisan.gov.in with Aadhaar and OTP.
Check the beneficiary status page for your name.
Complete patwari verification if the portal shows it pending.
Keep the bank account Aadhaar-linked so instalments do not bounce.
warnings: One family, one beneficiary — duplicate names get rejected
No fee is charged for registration; beware of touts promising faster payment

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
summary: Crop insurance against drought, flood, pests and other natural losses, with a low farmer premium share.
benefits: Compensation for crop loss due to natural calamities
Premium shared between farmer and government; farmer pays a small share
Localised calamity and post-harvest losses covered under conditions
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers with documents
Enrolment before the cut-off date of the season (Kharif / Rabi)
extra_costs: Farmer's premium share (small percentage of the sum insured) for notified crops
Bank charges, if any, for the linked account

where_to_go.office: Your bank branch, CSC, or the PMFBY portal
where_to_go.note: Loanee farmers are enrolled by the bank itself; non-loanee farmers enrol at the bank / CSC / portal

steps: Check the crop and area notification for your season on pmfby.gov.in.
Enrol through your bank, CSC or the portal before the cut-off date.
Keep the premium receipt and policy details safe.
If a loss occurs, report it within 72 hours through the crop insurance app or the bank / agriculture office.
warnings: Enrolment closes at the cut-off date; late applications are not accepted
Report crop loss within 72 hours — delays can forfeit the claim

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) — farm credit
summary: Low-interest credit for crop inputs and household needs under a single card, renewed periodically.
benefits: Working capital for seeds, fertiliser, and other inputs
Concessional interest on crop loans when repaid on time
Higher limits for dairy, fisheries and animal husbandry activities
eligibility: Owner cultivator, tenant farmer, sharecropper or oral lessee with land documents
Self-help groups and joint liability groups engaged in farming
extra_costs: No processing charge for small crop loans under the interest subvention scheme
Interest applies if the loan is not repaid within the due period

where_to_go.office: Your bank branch (any bank that offers KCC)
where_to_go.note: Take the filled application and the branch manager will guide the documentation

steps: Visit your bank branch and ask for the Kisan Credit Card application form.
Fill it with land, crop and family details.
Submit land records, Aadhaar and photographs.
The bank assesses the limit and issues the card.
Repay within the concessional window each season to keep the low interest.
warnings: A KCC is a loan, not a grant — repay on schedule
Only use official branch channels; no agent should charge for this form

name: CGHS — Central Government Health Scheme
summary: Health facilities for central government employees, pensioners and their dependants through CGHS dispensaries and empanelled hospitals.
benefits: OPD treatment, medicines and specialist referrals through CGHS wellness centres
Cashless or reimbursement-based treatment at empanelled hospitals
Cover continues for pensioners after retirement, with contributions
eligibility: Serving central government employees covered by the scheme
CGHS pensioners and their eligible dependants
Certain autonomous-body employees as notified
extra_costs: Monthly or annual CGHS contribution for pensioners (slab-based)
Some treatments and investigations have fixed user charges
Outside the CGHS city: reimbursement rates apply instead of cashless

where_to_go.office: Your nearest CGHS wellness centre, or the CGHS portal for card services
where_to_go.note: For a new card, apply through your office (serving) or the CGHS city office (pensioner)

steps: Get the CGHS card application (your office or the CGHS city office will give the format).
Attach photographs and service / pension documents.
Submit at the CGHS city office and pay the contribution where applicable.
Collect the card and use the nearest wellness centre for treatment.
For specialist or hospital care, take the referral from the wellness centre first.
warnings: Get the referral before admission to an empanelled hospital where required, or reimbursement can be cut
Check the current contribution slabs on cghs.gov.in — they are revised from time to time

name: Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) / NPS pension
summary: Pension arrangements for central government employees under the National Pension System and the newer Unified Pension Scheme option.
benefits: Assured pension option under UPS for eligible central government employees
Accumulated NPS corpus with market returns if you stay in NPS
Family pension and dearness relief features under UPS
eligibility: Central government employees covered by NPS who are eligible to choose UPS
Selection within the window notified by the government, at the start of service
extra_costs: Monthly employee contribution (salary-linked) plus the government share
Any gap contributions for prior service, where applicable

where_to_go.office: Your office's DDO / establishment section and the NPS / UPS online portal
where_to_go.note: Pensioners' queries are handled by the pension sanctioning authority of your department

steps: Ask your establishment section which pension option applies to your joining date.
Exercise the UPS option within the notified window, if eligible.
Verify your NPS statement on the portal every year.
At retirement, complete the pension papers with your office well in advance.
warnings: Pension choices may be irreversible after the window closes — read the official circular first
Verify everything on pensionersportal.gov.in; agents cannot speed up pension payments

name: NMC registration (medical practitioners)
summary: Registration with the National Medical Commission / state medical councils, the licence to practise medicine in India.
benefits: Legal licence to practise modern medicine in India
Registration number accepted for hospital jobs, prescriptions and certificates
Renewal keeps the licence active
eligibility: MBBS or higher degree from a recognised medical institution
Completed internship where required
Additional qualifications (PG, superspecialty) can be added to the registration
extra_costs: Registration and renewal fees set by the council
Document attestation and courier charges
PG / additional qualification endorsement fees

where_to_go.office: National Medical Commission portal for the central register; state medical council for licences
where_to_go.note: First registration is usually through the state council where your college is; NMC maintains the central register

steps: Create an account on the NMC / state council portal.
Fill the registration application with your qualification and internship details.
Upload degree, internship and identity documents.
Pay the prescribed fee and track the application.
Download the registration certificate once issued, and renew as notified.
warnings: Practise only with a valid registration; expired registrations cause legal trouble
Beware of fake 'fast-track registration' agents — all processing is on the official portal

name: PM-JAY empanelment (hospitals)
summary: For doctors running hospitals or nursing homes: empanelment with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY to treat card-holder patients cashless.
benefits: Cashless treatment for eligible patients, with packages paid to the hospital
A steady stream of card-holder patients
Standard rates published per package
eligibility: Hospital / nursing home with the required beds, registration and staff as per the empanelment guidelines
NABH / NABL accreditation or the state's alternative criteria
Facilities for the packages applied for
extra_costs: Application and inspection related charges, if any under state rules
Upgrades to meet package infrastructure requirements
Digital systems for claim submission

where_to_go.office: State Health Agency (SHA) of your state, through the PM-JAY empanelment portal
where_to_go.note: District level: the district health officer can guide the documents; decisions sit with the SHA

steps: Read the current empanelment guidelines on the state SHA website.
Apply online through the SHA / PM-JAY portal with hospital documents.
Prepare for inspection: records, staffing and packages.
Sign the memorandum after approval and start treating card holders.
Submit claims on the IT platform within the time limits.
Renew empanelment as notified.
warnings: Empanelment guidelines change; verify with your State Health Agency
Never pay an agent who 'guarantees' empanelment — the process is through the SHA

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) scholarships
summary: One portal for most central and many state scholarships, from pre-matric to higher education.
benefits: Scholarship amounts paid to the student's bank account
Central schemes (SC/ST/OBC/Minority/PwD) and state schemes in one place
Renewal applications for continuing students
eligibility: Varies by scheme: family income limits, category, marks and course
Aadhaar-linked bank account in the student's own name
Institute verification where required
extra_costs: Application is free
CSC service charge if you apply through a centre
Income / caste certificate fees where not already held

where_to_go.office: Online at scholarships.gov.in; help at your college's scholarship cell or CSC
where_to_go.note: Certificates are made at the tehsil / e-district portal of your state

steps: Register on scholarships.gov.in with Aadhaar and bank details.
Match the scheme to your category, course and income limit.
Upload certificates and marksheets; get the institute to verify.
Track the application and renewal deadlines each year.
Keep the bank account active — dormant accounts bounce payments.
warnings: Deadlines are strict; NSP does not accept late applications
Beware of fake scholarship websites that copy NSP's design — use scholarships.gov.in only

name: Vidya Lakshmi education loan (single window)
summary: One common application for education loans from multiple banks, with interest subsidy schemes where eligible.
benefits: Apply to several banks with one form
Section 80E tax benefit on education loan interest
Interest subsidy for eligible families under central schemes
eligibility: Admission to a recognised course / institution
Co-applicant (usually a parent) with income proof
Category and income conditions for subsidy schemes
extra_costs: Processing fees vary by bank; many waive for certain schemes
Margin money and collateral as per the bank's rules for higher amounts

where_to_go.office: Online at vidyalakshmi.co.in, then the bank branch
where_to_go.note: The portal shares your application with the banks you choose

steps: Register on vidyalakshmi.co.in and fill the common educational loan form.
Choose the banks you want to apply to.
Complete the bank's documentation and interviews as they ask.
Check interest subsidy eligibility through the National Scholarship Portal.
Track sanction and disbursal; keep receipts for tax and subsidy.
warnings: Compare the total interest across banks, not just the EMI
Subsidy schemes have income cut-offs and deadlines — check on NSP

name: Old-age pension (NSAP / state pensions)
summary: Monthly pensions for eligible senior citizens under the National Social Assistance Programme and state schemes.
benefits: Monthly pension credited to the bank / post office account
Higher amounts in many states beyond the central share
Separate widow and disability pensions under the same programme
eligibility: Age 60+ (higher for some states), below-poverty-line or as per state criteria
Not covered by another government pension in most states
Bank or post office account and Aadhaar
extra_costs: Application is free
Bank account formalities, if you do not have one yet

where_to_go.office: Gram panchayat / ward office or the state social welfare department portal; the block / tehsil office processes it
where_to_go.note: Ask the panchayat secretary or ward councillor for your state's exact counter

steps: Collect the pension application format from the panchayat / ward office or the state portal.
Fill it with age, BPL and bank details and attach proofs.
Submit where directed; get a receipt or application number.
Track the sanction and report within a month if the pension does not start.
Complete the annual life certificate / verification on time.
warnings: Pensions stop if the annual certification is missed — mark the date
No fee is charged for the application; beware of touts at counters

name: Udyam registration (MSME)
summary: Free online registration for micro, small and medium businesses, unlocking priority-sector benefits.
benefits: MSME identity used for subsidy, tender preference and collateral-free credit schemes
Priority sector lending benefits through banks
Delayed-payment protection from buyers under the MSME Act, where applicable
eligibility: Any enterprise meeting the MSME turnover and investment thresholds
Aadhaar and PAN of the owner / firm
extra_costs: Registration is free
CSC service fee only if you use a centre to file it

where_to_go.note: Use the same PAN as your business; the portal fetches ITR and GST data automatically

steps: Open udyamregistration.gov.in and choose the new registration option.
Register with Aadhaar / PAN; the portal pulls your business data.
Fill investment and turnover details for your category.
Submit and download the Udyam certificate immediately.
Quote the Udyam number in bank and tender applications.
warnings: Only udyamregistration.gov.in is official; lookalikes sell 'certificates' that are worthless
Keep investment / turnover figures honest — benefits are verified before sanction

name: PMEGP — subsidy for new micro-enterprises
summary: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up manufacturing or service micro-enterprises, run through KVIC.
benefits: Subsidy on the project cost: higher for special categories, lower for general
Margin money routed through the bank along with the loan
Training and hand-holding through KVIC / DIC
eligibility: Age 18+; individual, self-help group or cooperative
Only one subsidy per family under the scheme
New units only — existing units are not eligible
extra_costs: Your own contribution portion of the project cost
Project report preparation, if you hire a consultant (you can write it yourself)
Bank charges and insurance as per the lender

where_to_go.office: Online at the PMEGP portal, then the KVIC / KVIB / DIC office and your bank
where_to_go.note: The District Industry Centre (DIC) helps first-time applicants with the project file

steps: Open the PMEGP e-portal and register with your details.
Prepare a project report for your idea with cost and market estimates.
Apply online and choose the bank branch near you.
Attend the interview / EDP training if asked.
The bank sanctions the loan and releases the subsidy portion into the account.
warnings: Scheme rules and subsidy percentages change; confirm with your DIC / KVIC office before spending
No consultant can 'guarantee' the bank's sanction — do not pay large advance fees

name: PM SVANidhi — street vendor loans
summary: Working-capital micro-loans for street vendors, with interest subsidy and higher tranches on repayment.
benefits: Small working capital loan, with bigger repeat tranches on clean repayment
Interest subsidy credited to the account
Digital transaction incentives where applicable
eligibility: Street vendor with a certificate of vending or a letter of recommendation from the urban local body
Vendors who were surveyed by the urban local body
extra_costs: No collateral and no processing fee under the scheme

where_to_go.office: Urban local body / municipal office for the vendor certificate, then any bank or the portal
where_to_go.note: Ask at the ward office for the street vendor survey list and certificate

steps: Get the certificate of vending or recommendation letter from the urban local body.
Apply through the PM SVANidhi portal or your bank with the certificate.
Receive the first loan tranche after sanction.
Repay on schedule to unlock the next, larger tranche.
Use digital payments to earn the incentive where your bank supports it.
documents: Photograph of the vending spot where asked
warnings: The scheme has no processing fee; anyone demanding one is not official
Repay on time — repeat tranches depend on it

name: e-Shram card benefits
summary: Registration that gives unorganised workers a national identity plus accident cover under PMSBY registration.
benefits: e-Shram card as worker identity at government counters
Accident insurance cover linked through PMSBY where enrolled
Gateway to future welfare schemes for unorganised workers
eligibility: Unorganised sector worker aged 16–59
Aadhaar-linked mobile and bank account
extra_costs: Registration is free
PMSBY accident cover has a small annual premium where you enrol (often auto-debited by your bank)

where_to_go.note: No physical office visit is needed

steps: Register on eshram.gov.in with Aadhaar and OTP.
Download the e-Shram card PDF.
Check with your bank that PMSBY accident cover is active on your account.
Update occupation details if you change work.
warnings: CSCs must not charge for e-Shram registration — report any centre that does
The card alone does not pay benefits; check each linked scheme's rules

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY health cover
summary: Free hospitalisation cover for eligible families at empanelled hospitals, checked against government databases.
benefits: Cashless hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals for eligible families
Covers the family on one card, including elderly members
Pre-existing conditions covered from day one of the scheme
eligibility: Families listed in SECC / state eligibility databases (check on the portal)
Senior citizens aged 70+ under the expanded cover where notified
extra_costs: The card is free
Non-covered items and non-empanelled hospitals are paid by the patient

where_to_go.office: pmjay.gov.in, a CSC, or the help desk of any empanelled hospital
where_to_go.note: Check the family on the beneficiary portal before going to hospital for planned treatment

steps: Check eligibility with Aadhaar and OTP on the beneficiary portal.
Generate and save the Ayushman card.
Confirm the hospital is empanelled for your treatment.
Show the card at the hospital help desk; they verify and admit cashless.
warnings: Nobody should charge you for the card — it is free
Verify empanelment before admission; outside the network it is not cashless

name: DigiLocker — keep documents safe
summary: Government digital wallet for PAN, licence, certificates and more, legally valid as digital copies.
benefits: Fewer paper copies to carry and lose
Documents issued directly by departments, so they verify everywhere
Share with a verification QR instead of photocopies
eligibility: Anyone with a mobile number or Aadhaar
extra_costs: Free

where_to_go.office: Online only (digilocker.gov.in or the official app)
where_to_go.note: Some documents require your Aadhaar for the first-time fetch

steps: Create the account with mobile / Aadhaar and OTP.
Fetch your issued documents from departments.
Use the app's share feature when an office asks for a copy.
warnings: Use only digilocker.gov.in or the official app; lookalike sites steal logins
